titulo_es: Useful Posters and Signals: Integrated Reading
intro: It recognizes prohibitions, obligations and basic services in public spaces. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It recognizes prohibitions, obligations and basic services in public spaces. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention point: In a signal, the imperative or « interdit » usually expresses a rule; the icon and the place provide context. In this fragment, «entrée» means «entry».

frases.fr: À l'entrée du parc, un panneau indique « Ouvert de 8 h à 18 h ».
frases.es: En la entrada del parque, un cartel indica «Abierto de 8 a 18».
frases.en: At the park entrance, a sign indicates «Open from 8 to 18».

frases.fr: Les chiens doivent rester en laisse près du jardin.
frases.es: Los perros deben ir con correa cerca del jardín.
frases.en: Dogs must go with a leash near the garden.

frases.fr: La sortie se trouve derrière le café, à gauche.
frases.es: La salida está detrás del café, a la izquierda.
frases.en: The exit is behind the coffee, on the left.

frases.fr: Les toilettes sont gratuites et ouvertes au public.
frases.es: Los baños son gratuitos y están abiertos al público.
frases.en: The bathrooms are free and open to the public.
